en_us: New villages have house-workshops: the street south of the plaza has 2 homes of job households (3 in Valeholm), and one makes food. Valeholm workshops are Norse long houses. Sunreach workshops of the fields, food, wood and stone are flat houses. Forges have no job sign.
fr_fr: Nouveaux villages : la rue au sud de la place a 2 maisons-ateliers de familles de métier (3 à Valeholm), dont une produit de la nourriture. Ateliers de Valeholm : maisons longues nordiques. Ateliers de Sunreach (champs, nourriture, bois, pierre) : maisons plates. Forges sans panneau de métier.
